title: A flow collection directly after the colon of an empty key
notes: An entry with an empty key is production 146: an empty node, then production 147. The `:` must be followed by white space before a value node (`s-separate` then `ns-flow-node`) or by nothing at all. Only a JSON-like key may have its value right after the `:` (production 149), and an empty key is not one. In `{:{0}}` the `:` is not followed by a plain-safe character, so it is the indicator, the entry then has an empty value, and the second `{`, at column 3, cannot continue the mapping (it needs `,` or `}`). Compare diagnostics/plain-key-with-adjacent-flow-value-is-invalid.

provenance.reference: Found while reading the source of a library whose flow mapping reader accepted a flow collection right after the colon of an empty key.
